spec_match.rationale: Records the real dispatch order of resize, mql change, transitionrun/start and rAF callbacks within rendering iterations, annotated with the spec's update-the-rendering step numbers.

interactive.rationale: Cross-the-breakpoint and Clear both work; a run produced a 10-entry record with iteration-break dividers before clearing (verified in sequence).

blurb_alignment.rationale: Blurb says the sequence is the browser's, not a description of one — the record is built from live listeners.

edge_cases.rationale: Handles no-crossing and no-transition branches with precise guidance, and removes listeners after four frames so a stuck run cannot leak.

conformance.rationale: Shares the feature suite (4 pass / 2 fail here); the failing same-iteration assertions correspond to exactly what this page's record shows on this build.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Live run recorded the change at one frame and transitionrun after an iteration break — the deferred (pre-fix) ordering — displayed with the correct explanation; console clean.

telemetry_health.rationale: iteration-recorded always fires true; asserting changeFrame !== null on a crossing run would make it meaningful.

design_system.rationale: Step list and record table use the shared variables; seen-steps highlighted with AA-safe emerald on paper.

accessibility.rationale: Buttons named, output aria-live, iframe titled, visible focus throughout.

openQuestions.title: Re-verify the recorded order once a stable 153 build has the fix
openQuestions.detail: On this 153.0.8010.12 build the record still shows transitionrun one iteration after the mql change (matching the 2 failing conformance assertions). When a stable 153 confirms the aligned behaviour, this page's record should show both in the same iteration — re-run and refresh this critique then.

summary: Verified on headless Chromium 153 (Chrome for Testing 153.0.8010.12) driven over CDP via a Playwright script — chrome-devtools-mcp is unavailable in this cloud environment; desktop 1280×800 and mobile 360×740 DPR3 full-page screenshots captured and inspected. The recorder works and honestly displayed the deferred ordering this build still has; the detail copy correctly identified it as the pre-fix behaviour.
